name: codex
description: The Codex of Realms — Notion sync (legacy) plus the absorbed lore-keeper: world codex, node backstories, chronicles, and the player journal. Owns codex_entries, node_lore, chronicles, journal_entries in the game sidecar DB (~/.realmwatch/game.db).

cli.summary: Browse and inscribe realm lore — codex entries, node backstories, chronicles, and the player journal

verbs.name: entries
verbs.summary: List world-lore codex entries (category, fantasy + technical name, summary)

verbs.name: chronicles
verbs.summary: List recent chronicles, newest first (title + narrative)
verbs.table: (.chronicles // [])[] | [(.chronicle_date // 0 | if . == 0 then "-" else (./1000 | floor | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) end), .title // "-", (.narrative // "-")]

verbs.name: journal
verbs.summary: List player journal entries, newest first (type, title, content)
verbs.table: (.entries // [])[] | [(.created_ts // 0 | if . == 0 then "-" else (./1000 | floor | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) end), .entry_type // "-", .title // "-", (.content // "-")]

verbs.name: add-entry
verbs.summary: Upsert a world-lore codex entry: add-entry <codex_id> <summary> (use --json for the persisted row)

verbs.name: add-journal
verbs.summary: Add a player journal entry: add-journal <title> <content>
